description: Sort images you sent to a space (upload_file with space_id) into its collections, as a drop in the app: each lands in the collection and group it fits, and images that fit none start a new collection. The answer says where each landed, with app links, and gives a drop_id: undo_drop takes the whole drop back within a day. Sorting looks at every image, so a big drop takes up to a minute.

collection_id.description: One of this space's own collections from list_space (no from_space_id): sort into its groups only, as a drop on its page.

name.description: What to call a new collection for images that fit none, such as the folder they came from.

space_id.description: The space the images were sent to.

name: add_images
title: Add images to collections
